author: Maya Lin (Orbit Health)
text: Our scheduled agent errored at 2am. We only found out when the team asked where the report was. Is there any way to get pinged when a run fails?

author: Jonas Weber (Freightly)
text: I need to know when the cron run breaks. Right now I check the console by hand every morning.

author: Sam Ortiz (Tallybook)
text: I need the agent to call our billing API. I don't want the key in the prompt. What's the right place to put it so the agent can use it but can't leak it?

author: Maya Lin (Orbit Health)
text: The agent says it wrote report.pdf to outputs, but I can't work out how to download it after the session. The docs mention a scope thing I don't get.

author: Dev Patel (Quillstack)
text: We changed the instructions last week and I have a feeling the output got worse, but I can't prove it. Is there a standard way to score runs over time?
